verdict.rationale: Canny has documented developer resources (developers.canny.io) and an llms.txt for AI-discoverable docs, plus an official MCP server enabling LLM-driven workflows (querying feedback, updating statuses). However, no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (404s on all candidate paths), suggesting the REST API itself isn't formally machine-documented for arbitrary AI-native API-driving beyond the MCP layer. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, independent confirmation of full REST API coverage beyond MCP-curated actions.
